windows.notes: Settings has a new look on Mac, Windows and Linux: a clean sidebar with search, your account pinned at the bottom, and simple rows in light or dark. Models & providers now has Overview, Browse and Providers tabs. Every setting is still here.

mac.notes: Sign-in works again on every platform. On Mac, the sign-in window uses the standard Continue with Google, Microsoft, GitHub or email buttons with official logos, and the browser's Open Refract button now takes you straight back (choose Always allow once).

linux.notes: Settings has a new look on Mac, Windows and Linux: a clean sidebar with search, your account pinned at the bottom, and simple rows in light or dark. Models & providers now has Overview, Browse and Providers tabs. Every setting is still here.
